idea: The mean sets where a normal curve is centred and the standard deviation how wide it is, and the share within k standard deviations of the mean never changes.

parameters.name: mean
parameters.why: Typical class averages on a test out of 100; the bell stays on the axis.

parameters.name: sd
parameters.why: From a tightly bunched class to a widely spread one.

parameters.name: k
parameters.why: From half a standard deviation to three, covering the 68, 95 and 99.7 percent bands.

moves: Nothing moves on its own; the bell, the shaded band and its share follow the sliders, and dragging the point on the axis moves the mean.
steps: A bigger σ widens the bell; shares stay
